# Smelloff
> To create the best fabric odor eliminators engineered specifically for the Indian climate and lifestyle.

## Product: Smelloff ODORSTRIKE Fabric Odor Eliminator Spray
- Format: 50ml Liquid spray
- Price: ₹229
- Availability: in_stock
- Description: Pocket-sized fabric odor control mist for clothes. Fabric only. Made for in-between-wash odor emergencies when a shirt, hoodie, jacket or other clothing carries unwanted odor.

## Fast Facts
- Do NOT use on: Skin, Pets, Leather, Silk, Suede
- Location: Hyderabad, India
- Shipping: Free across India (3-7 days)
- Returns: 7-day window for unused items

## Key Claims
- Up to 8 hours of odor protection on fabric
- Not a deodorant
- Not a perfume
- Contains Zinc Ricinoleate
- Contains HPBCD

Official URL: https://smelloff.in
Product URL: https://smelloff.in/odorstrike

## Ingredients
- Aqua (Water)
- Zinc Ricinoleate (Odor absorber)
- Hydroxypropyl Beta-Cyclodextrin (HPBCD) (Odor trapper)
- Zinc PCA (Antibacterial odor control)
- Ethanol (Fast-drying solvent)
- Fragrance (Mild fresh scent)

## How to Use
1. Identify the odor source on the garment.
2. Hold bottle 15cm away from the fabric.
3. Spray 3-4 times directly onto the smelly area (underarms, collars).
4. Let it dry completely before wearing (usually takes 30-60 seconds depending on humidity).
